source_evidence: Exact player 'Yes that is only fair. You can’t help your hunger, and it’s better you feed off the willing then drain some unknowing bloke' accepts Caul's conditional offer of recognition as a steward of House Vaishnavi IF she demonstrates genuine voluntary prosperity and allegiance, and supports willing rather than unwilling blood contributions. This is not immediate appointment, unconditional recognition, blanket endorsement of Caul's past or present regime, forgiveness, fealty oath, funding transfer, legal title or acceptance of unrelated coercion. Caul pleased, regards opportunity to earn position as valuable and agrees to Cirren's stipulations within the proposed one-community trial: genuinely free and informed participation, no magical compulsion, no retaliation for refusal or departure, no feeding that endangers life; compensation for willing work and blood contributors, favorable commercial terms, actual protection. No universal quota, feeding method, invented biological safety threshold, new mechanics, procurement or guaranteed result. Cirren remains wary of her conduct outside trial and insists actual outcomes matter; Caul acknowledges success must be demonstrated rather than presumed. The trial is authorized in principle by both, but Caul has not selected community, issued local implementation orders, allocated actual funds, obtained residents' assent or proven success; she will independently develop practical terms and pursue implementation using her own available resources and actual elapsed campaign time; no V gold, automatic estate registration, or new result. Existing unconditional captive release order remains separately dispatched D33420:07 via existing yard Guard, earliest04:07 D335 arrival; no delivery/release yet. Caul confirms willingness to discuss tower handover independently of trial success, but no specific handover order or legal conveyance established in this exchange. V next decision on tower/other matters. D334~20:09, no rolls for ordinary mutually agreed conditional terms, no combat/Charm, expenditures, rest, movement or resource changes.
